home-first.title: Practicar on a first visit
home-first.job: Someone who has never seen the site understands within a few seconds what it is for and how to start.

A.caption: Empezar starts a 3-minute routine of two exercises with the microphone. The exercise list continues below.

B.caption: Empezar starts a 3-minute routine of two exercises with the microphone. The exercise list continues below.

home-returning.title: Practicar for someone who has practised before
home-returning.job: A learner who has practised on earlier days sees what to do today, can pick another exercise, and is not distracted by things that belong elsewhere.

A.caption: 'Otras formas de practicar' opens: continue where you left off, or start a guided session. Below the exercise list, 'Tu estudio' shows totals, a weekly session goal, achievements, a practice map and Pro offers, and 'Volver a practicar' sets a daily reminder or starts a 5-minute exercise.

B.caption: 'Otras formas de practicar' opens: pick an exercise (jumps to the list), continue where you left off, or start a guided session. '🔔 Poner un recordatorio' opens a small dialog to set a daily reminder. Totals, achievements and the practice map are in Historial, under 'Tu progreso'.

catalog-order.title: The exercise list
catalog-order.job: A learner looking for an exercise can scan the list, understand how it is organised, and find a good place to start.

A.caption: Tapping a card opens that exercise. A row of shortcuts above the list opens each exercise in today's basics; 'Hoy en tus básicos' marks the same exercises in the list.

B.caption: Tapping a card opens that exercise. 'Hoy en tus básicos' marks the exercises in today's basics.

history-progress.title: Historial for someone with saved practice
history-progress.job: A learner who opens Historial sees what they have done and can tell whether they are making progress.

A.caption: Totals, achievements and the practice map are on Practicar, below the exercise list, not here. 'Abrir' opens that exercise.

B.caption: 'Abrir' opens that exercise. Pro offers appear here at most one at a time.

reminder.title: Setting a daily reminder
reminder.job: A learner who wants a daily nudge to practise finds where to set it and sets it.

A.caption: The reminder settings are in 'Volver a practicar' at the very bottom of Practicar, below the exercise list (the second screenshot is scrolled there).

B.caption: '🔔 Poner un recordatorio' on the week card opens a small dialog (the second screenshot). Once a reminder is set, the button reads 'Recordatorio: 18:00'.
